nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Overview and usage guide for the Personal Job Agent, a local-first career intelligence agent that discovers, normalizes, scores, tailors, and tracks jobs against a structured career profile with human approval gates. Covers 14 sections: profile policy (€120k salary floor), concepts (sources, normalization, scoring, lifecycle, digest, career fit/documents/tailoring), the M3-local web UI with API endpoints, CLI commands, configuration, and safety guarantees; declares the MVP working and ready for real-world usage.

nodes.name: config.example.yaml
nodes.summary: Template configuration for the job agent that users copy to config.yaml and edit. Declares profile/database/report paths, the Ollama LLM client settings, global search bounds, salary floor (€120k) and target (€150k), ranking weights, digest output, career knowledge/weights/LLM narrative settings, and placeholder sources whose 'example' tokens are skipped by discovery so a fresh checkout never hits the network.

nodes.name: config.yaml
nodes.summary: Live runtime configuration for the job agent: Ollama LLM endpoint (qwen3.5:9b), aggressive global search across DE/AT/CH/NL/DK/SE/NO/ES/UK locations and target product-program roles with positive/negative keyword filters, salary floor and target, scoring weights prioritizing similarity, compensation and leadership, and a curated sources list (example placeholders plus three direct-company domains).

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Packaging and tooling metadata for the personal-job-agent package: core dependencies (httpx, pydantic, PyYAML, rapidfuzz, trafilatura, python-docx, pypdf), optional extras (llm, playwright, discovery, dev, all), the `job-agent` console script, plus pytest, ruff, and mypy configuration that relaxes strictness for latent pre-Slice-1 modules and the external parent personal_ai package.
nodes.languageNotes: Setuptools-based single package layout with per-file ruff ignores and mypy overrides for unwired legacy modules kept out of strict checking.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Single-line requirements file containing `-e .`, installing the personal-job-agent package in editable mode with dependencies resolved from pyproject.toml.

nodes.name: sources_catalog.yaml
nodes.summary: Versioned, provenance-tracked inventory of 42 job sources the job agent may discover through, categorized by source type (9 ATS platforms, 13 structured-data, 12 search engines, 8 restricted/browser-automation). Each entry declares discovery method, query host, rate-limit class, priority, and enabled flag; disabled entries retain a reason so bot-hostile or ToS-bound sites are never probed, and selection by career track is deterministic via catalog.py.
nodes.languageNotes: Data-heavy YAML registry with a governing header documenting field semantics and CC0 provenance from the emredurukn/awesome-job-boards index.
